proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2757 kaphoṇi gives Prakrit kuhaṇī, Hindi kohnī/kehunī, Nepali kuhunu/kuinu, Bengali kanui, Oriya kahuṇi and Gujarati koṇī elbow. The selected regional kuh-/ko-/keun- forms fit this nasal elbow family with h placement, contraction, vowel order and source dental/retroflex nasal notation retained. The article discusses competing Munda/Dravidian deeper connections; those and local Indo-Aryan transmission remain unresolved. Exact response: kʰũni.
